Noema — steer the neural world model

Drag the pad to set an intended movement. The world model imagines the population's firing in response and decodes it back into motion — running live in your browser, weights matched to the trained model.

A compact model trained on synthetic action-driven dynamics; the browser runs its exact forward pass (verified against PyTorch to 1e-5).
